name: Running models efficiently
gist: Making models faster and smaller so they can run on phones and edge devices without losing accuracy or requiring expensive hardware.
explain: Multimodal models are enormous. To connect images and text, you need a capable image encoder (a deep neural network that understands images) and a language model (a neural network trained on vast text), and then something to fuse them together. Put together, these models can have billions of parameters — settings that need to be stored and computed. A large model might weigh several gigabytes, which won't fit on a phone or even a laptop. Yet the world wants multimodal AI everywhere: on mobile devices, in apps, at the edge where data is generated. Running a model efficiently means either making it smaller, making it faster, or both, without losing too much accuracy — because users expect instant responses and low power drain, so the model has to do more work with less compute.

The tension is fundamental. A bigger model usually learns better because it has more capacity to memorize patterns and generalize from them. But size comes with a cost: slower computation, higher memory usage, and more energy drain. For a phone app, battery life matters. For a data center with millions of requests, speed matters — if you can halve the time per request, you can serve twice as many users with the same hardware. There is a tradeoff space: you can compress the model by removing or shrinking layers, use quantization to store numbers in lower precision (using fewer bits), or use techniques like knowledge distillation where a smaller model learns to imitate a larger one. But each technique has tradeoffs: smaller can mean loss of understanding, and the model might fail on hard cases.

Researchers in this area are building models that are smart about what they compute. Some use techniques where only important parts of the input are processed in detail, and less-important parts are handled more cheaply. Others design models that work in stages: a fast but rough first pass, then a more detailed second pass only if needed. Some train models specifically to be small and fast from the start, using special training objectives that penalize size. The goal is the same across all approaches: get a model that fits in a phone, runs in milliseconds, and still understands images and text well enough to be useful.

papers.title: ACTIVE-o3 : Empowering MLLMs with Active Perception via Pure Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Equips MLLMs with active perception capabilities while preserving general understanding; enhances performance on small/dense-object grounding and domain-specific scenarios.

papers.title: ETGS: Explicit Thermodynamics Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Thermal Reconstruction
papers.contribution: Captures rapid thermal dynamics more accurately than static and dynamic baselines while maintaining efficiency comparable to static 3DGS.

papers.title: Entropy-Monitored Kernelized Token Distillation for Audio-Visual Compression
papers.contribution: Uses 94% fewer parameters while preserving 96.9% performance on audio-visual event recognition and 96.5% on audio-visual segmentation.

papers.title: PPE: Positional Preservation Embedding for Token Compression in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: PPE achieves consistent improvements of 2-5% across multiple vision-language benchmarks (MMBench, TextVQA, VideoMME) without requiring parameter additions.

papers.title: Pulp Motion: Framing-aware multimodal camera and human motion generation
papers.contribution: First to address joint text-conditioned generation maintaining consistent on-screen framing across both modalities with gains on textual alignment.

papers.title: SketchThinker-R1: Towards Efficient Sketch-Style Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models
papers.contribution: Achieves over 64% reduction in reasoning token cost without compromising answer accuracy while focusing reasoning on key problem-solving cues.

papers.title: U-MARVEL: Unveiling Key Factors for Universal Multimodal Retrieval via Embedding Learning with MLLMs
papers.contribution: U-MARVEL outperforms state-of-the-art competitors on M-BEIR by a large margin in supervised settings and exhibits strong zero-shot performance on composed image retrieval and text-to-video retrieval.

papers.title: Uni-DocRobust: Universal Plug-and-Play Robustness Enhancement for Multi-modal LLMs via Feature Restoration
papers.contribution: With DocRobust-VQA (189K clean/corrupted pairs, 417K QA pairs), Uni-DocRobust significantly enhances robust MLLM performance across architectures via a cost-effective pre-train-once-deploy-everywhere paradigm.

papers.title: Adaptive Querying with AI Persona Priors
papers.contribution: Delivers accurate probabilistic predictions and interpretable adaptive elicitation pipeline on synthetic data and WorldValuesBench with closed-form posterior updates.

papers.title: Beyond Next-Token Alignment: Distilling Multimodal Large Language Models via Token Interactions
papers.contribution: 2.6% relative improvement over vanilla KD; distilled Align-TI-2B outperforms LLaVA-1.5-7B by 7.0%, establishing state-of-the-art parameter-efficient MLLM distillation.

papers.title: CoLA: Cross-Modal Low-rank Adaptation for Multimodal Downstream Tasks
papers.contribution: Achieves relative gains of ~3% on vision-language benchmarks (RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg) and ~2% on audio-visual (AVE, AVS) tasks while maintaining parameter efficiency, enabling the first multi-task PEFT framework for visual grounding.

papers.title: ConsMSA: Semantic Distribution Consistency Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS while remaining robust under aggressive token compression, retaining only 10% of tokens yields comparable accuracy.

papers.title: DVD-Quant: Data-free Video Diffusion Transformers Quantization
papers.contribution: DVD-Quant achieves 2x speedup for Video DiTs while maintaining visual fidelity, enabling first W4A4 PTQ without quality compromise.

papers.title: Distilling Neuro-Symbolic Programs into 3D Multi-modal LLMs
papers.contribution: Unifies neuro-symbolic transparency with MLLM flexibility, matching state-of-the-art performance on 3D spatial reasoning while maintaining interpretable reasoning.

papers.title: Dive into the Scene: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Vision-Language Decision Making via Focus Plan Generation
papers.contribution: Substantially reduces visual hallucinations for both VLMs and VLAs while preserving computational efficiency on embodied AI benchmarks.

papers.title: Dual Latent Memory for Visual Multi-agent System
papers.contribution: Breaks the scaling wall with 2.7-5.4% average accuracy improvement while reducing token usage by 21.3-44.8%, demonstrating strong scalability across backbones and structures.

papers.title: Dual-Latent Memory Routing for Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.contribution: Substantial gains on general and reasoning benchmarks with minimal trainable parameters; interpretable routing with reduced decoding tokens.

papers.title: Efficient Multimodal Spatial Reasoning via Dynamic and Asymmetric Routing
papers.contribution: Achieves 40.37% FLOPs reduction and 46.07% KV-cache reduction while preserving or improving performance across seven spatial reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: FRISM: Fine-Grained Reasoning Injection via Subspace-Level Model Merging for Vision–Language Models
papers.contribution: FRISM effectively improves reasoning while largely preserving visual capabilities across diverse visual-language reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: Fed-Duet: Dual Expert-Orchestrated Framework for Continual Federated Vision-Language Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance and stability in federated continual learning for vision-language models compared to existing approaches.

papers.title: FlowNar: Scalable Streaming Narration for Long-Form Videos
papers.contribution: Substantially improves narration quality over baselines while supporting 10× longer videos and achieving 3× higher throughput on Ego4D, EgoExo4D, and EpicKitchens100.

papers.title: Gogo: Group-wise granularity-ordered codec for stable and efficient speech generation
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction at 47 tokens and state-of-the-art results in long-form speech generation with adaptive token reduction.

papers.title: Histopathology-Genomics Multi-modal Structural Representation Learning for Data-Efficient Precision Oncology
papers.contribution: On TCGA datasets with 7,263 cases across survival prediction, cancer grading, and gene mutation tasks, MSRL improves over missing-genomics methods by 1.44% to 3.12% in C-Index.

papers.title: Hyper-ICL: Attention Calibration with Hyperbolic Anchor Distillation for Multimodal In-Context Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently improves accuracy and stability across six benchmarks (VQAv2, OK-VQA, COCO Caption) over vanilla ICL and existing methods.

papers.title: MARC: Memory-Augmented RL Token Compression for Efficient Video Understanding
papers.contribution: MARC reduces computational overhead while maintaining video understanding performance through retrieve-then-compress architecture.

papers.title: MoRA: Missing Modality Low-Rank Adaptation for Visual Recognition
papers.contribution: Achieves 5.24% average improvement in missing-modality scenarios using only 0.11% of full fine-tuning parameters and 25.90% of inference time.

papers.title: Multimodal Dataset Distillation Made Simple by Prototype-guided Data Synthesis
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms optimization-based distillation and subset selection, achieving state-of-the-art cross-architecture generalization without full-dataset training.

papers.title: NAIPv2: Debiased Pairwise Learning for Efficient Paper Quality Estimation
papers.contribution: We present NAIPv2, a debiased and efficient framework for paper quality estimation.

papers.title: Nüwa: Mending the Spatial Integrity Torn by VLM Token Pruning
papers.contribution: Nuwa achieves state-of-the-art VQA performance (94% to 95%) and substantial improvements on visual grounding tasks (7% to 47%), demonstrating effective spatial integrity preservation.

papers.title: PRIM：Cooperative Dynamic Token Compression for Efficient Large Multimodal Models
papers.contribution: PRIM consistently achieves superior efficiency-accuracy trade-offs across audio-visual benchmarks through modality-specific and layer-wise adaptive compression strategies.

papers.title: Point-MoE: Large-Scale Multi-Dataset Training with Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Semantic Segmentation
papers.contribution: Point-MoE outperforms prior methods on seen and zero-shot settings without dataset labels, enabling scalable 3D perception discovery.

papers.title: RADIO1D: Elastic Representations for Condensed Vision Modeling
papers.contribution: RADIO1D provides flexible accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs through adjustable token counts, delivering competitive VLM performance with lower computational overhead and better accuracy.

papers.title: RATE-DISTORTION OPTIMIZED COMMUNICATION FOR COLLABORATIVE PERCEPTION
papers.contribution: RDcomm achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on 3D detection and BEV segmentation while reducing communication volume by up to 108x.

papers.title: SLQ: Bridging Modalities via Shared Latent Queries for Retrieval with Frozen MLLMs
papers.contribution: Outperforms full fine-tuning and LoRA on COCO and Flickr30K while achieving substantial gains on knowledge-aware retrieval.

papers.title: ST-SimDiff: Balancing Spatiotemporal Similarity and Difference for Efficient Video Understanding with MLLMs
papers.contribution: ST-SimDiff significantly outperforms state-of-the-art video understanding approaches while substantially reducing computational costs with minimal token count.

papers.title: Seeing is Solving: Unlocking Efficient Multimodal RL via View Alignment
papers.contribution: Achieves 2.5x–4x faster convergence over vanilla GRPO and +4.4 average accuracy gains across six benchmarks and multiple VLM families.

papers.title: SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves significant improvements across spatial and general tasks, scoring 71.6 on VSI-Bench (first model exceeding 70) and transfers to embodied manipulation.

papers.title: Spectral-Progressive Thought Flow for Lightweight Multimodal Reasoning
papers.contribution: Reduces computation and memory costs by up to 2.1x while achieving competitive or superior reasoning performance.

papers.title: Task-Related Token Compression in Multimodal Large Language Models from an Explainability Perspective
papers.contribution: Achieves significant token reduction with negligible performance loss across 13 benchmarks on three leading MLLMs without architecture modification.

papers.title: UHR-BAT: Budget-Aware Token Compression Vision-Language model for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks while efficiently handling query-critical fine details in kilometer-scale imagery.

papers.title: UniLiP: Adapting CLIP for Unified Multimodal Understanding, Generation and Editing
papers.contribution: With only 1B-3B parameters, UniLIP achieves 0.90 GenEval, 0.63 WISE, 3.94 ImgEdit scores, outperforming larger 7B-12B unified models.

papers.title: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with Shared Context—Visual Tokenizer is Key to Unification
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on image generation and editing while remaining competitive on multimodal understanding benchmarks.

papers.title: Universal Skeleton Understanding via Differentiable Rendering and MLLMs
papers.contribution: Demonstrates universal skeleton understanding with strong generalization across recognition, captioning, reasoning, and cross-format transfer tasks.

papers.title: VisionPulse: Dynamic Visual Sparsity for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.contribution: Retains only 5% of visual tokens per step with reasoning traces shortened by 11.2% while keeping accuracy almost unchanged.

papers.title: When MLLMs Meets Compression Distortion: A Coding Paradigm Tailored to MLLMs
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 35.99% bitrate saving while maintaining MLLM task performance, outperforming previous neural codecs.

papers.title: Zooming without Zooming: Region-to-Image Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
papers.contribution: Student model improves fine-grained perception without tool use and achieves leading performance on multiple fine-grained benchmarks while improving visual reasoning and GUI agents.
